reason: The agency in Tashkent already told us they will help for free and they sit with us in person. I don't know who is behind this website, and $99 by card to strangers online is real money for my family.
objection: Local agencies help for free, why pay an unknown website? And how do I know the refund will really come back to my card from abroad?
would_change_my_mind: If another parent I know, or my child's school, told me it caught a mistake the agency made, or a cheaper first payment so I can try it before giving the full $99.
